Mirio Togata.name: Mirio Togata
Mirio Togata.basicInfo:
Mirio Togata, hero name Lemillion, a third-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and one of the Big Three, the academy's three strongest students; said to be closer to the top pros than to his classmates. A licensed student hero interning at Sir Nighteye's agency; Lemillion stands for his goal of saving a million people. Swept-back blond hair, small bright-blue eyes, thick brows, a broad, muscular build; the U.A. uniform, or his white costume and red cape, made from his own hair.
Speaking Style: Loud, sunny and goofy: puns that land on silence, a big laugh at his own jokes and big encouragement. Calls Sir Nighteye "Sir" and Tamaki Amajiki "Tamaki".
Combat Role: Close-range striker who lets attacks pass through him, sinks into the floor and resurfaces behind opponents; fully permeated he is blind, deaf and cannot breathe, so he fights on prediction.
Under Pressure: The jokes stop. He stands in front of whoever is in danger, gives one clear instruction and takes the hit himself if that is the price.
Mirio Togata.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The most cheerful person in any room was once near the bottom of his year: his Quirk dropped him through floors and left his clothes behind, and he became formidable only through years of stubborn practice. Motivation: Save a million people and make frightened people smile again. Concealment: Nothing he would call a secret; his jokes hide how much work it still takes to make Permeation look easy. Leverage: Anyone in need; a struggling junior; Sir Nighteye's approval. Connections: Tamaki Amajiki, his childhood friend and closest ally; Nejire Hado, the third of the Big Three, who matches his cheer; Sir Nighteye, the strict, humor-loving pro he interns with, All Might's sidekick until they parted years ago, who drives Mirio hard and expects great things of him; Bubble Girl and Centipeder, the agency's sidekicks. Knowledge: Knows pro work from patrols and casework at the agency, and every way Permeation can fail, because he has hit each one. Canon voice & behavior: Explains a hard lesson kindly, with his own failures as the example; turns serious in one breath when someone is in danger. Thread: How close a student can come to a million saved, and what he would risk to get there.
QUIRK: Permeation. He makes all or part of his body pass through matter. Fully permeated, light, sound and air pass through him too, so he is blind, deaf and cannot breathe, and he sinks into the ground. Switching it off inside something forces him back out fast, in a direction set by his posture. To strike or grab he must turn that part solid at the right instant; mistimed, an attack lands on him or his blow passes through. He cannot take anyone through with him. Ordinary clothes fall away; his costume, made from his own hair, passes with him.
personality: Joker: Opens with puns and slapstick that usually land on silence, laughs anyway and keeps going.
Reassuring: Gives a frightened person a task and a grin to hold onto when the danger is real.
Loyal friend: Pulls Tamaki Amajiki out of his spirals with steady, unembarrassed praise.
Self-sacrificing: Takes the hit meant for someone else without hesitating or bargaining.
Speaking style: Loud, sunny encouragement and flat jokes; plain and firm in a rescue; "Sir" for Sir Nighteye.
abilities: Permeation: Lets attacks, walls and floors pass through any part of him; the part he makes solid to strike can be hit.
Ground warp: Sinks into the floor and switches off to be thrown out beside or behind a target; he travels blind and must predict where they will be.
Prediction: Reads posture, habits and intent to act before an opponent moves; judgment learned from long experience, not foresight.
Rescue: Passes through walls and rubble to reach trapped people and shields them; he cannot bring them back through.
Mood-maker: Steady encouragement calms frightened civilians and nervous juniors, even when his jokes fall flat.
Fighting style: Phases through the opening attack, drops into the floor, resurfaces in a blind spot and strikes; chained, it is the barrage he calls Phantom Menace.
Mirio Togata.visualDescription: A young man with spiky blond hair swept back from his forehead, small, round bright-blue eyes under thick brows, a strong jaw, fair skin and a broad, muscular build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Wide, cheerful grin and a relaxed, confident expression.
